items.translation: environment - 需要修改的环境

items.source: pairs - the name-value pairs for properties that need to be added to the environment
items.translation: pairs - 需要添加到环境中的属性的名称 - 值对

items.translation: 返回一个空的TestPropertyValues实例。

items.source: Return a new TestPropertyValues with the underlying map populated with the given stream.
items.translation: 返回一个新的TestPropertyValues，其底层映射由给定流填充。

items.source: type - the type of PropertySource to be added. See TestPropertyValues.Type
items.translation: type - 要添加的 PropertySource 的类型。请参阅 TestPropertyValues.Type

items.source: mapper - a mapper function to convert an element from the stream into a TestPropertyValues.Pair
items.translation: `mapper` - 一个映射函数，用于将流中的元素转换为 TestPropertyValues.Pair。

items.source: map - the map of properties that need to be added to the environment
items.translation: map - 需要添加到环境中的属性映射。

items.source: stream - the elements that need to be added to the environment
items.translation: stream - 需要添加到环境中的元素

items.source: Test utilities for adding properties. Properties can be applied to a Spring Environment or to the system environment.
items.translation: 用于添加属性的测试工具。属性可以应用于 Spring Environment 或 系统环境。

items.source: Add the properties to the system properties for the duration of the action, restoring previous values when it completes.
items.translation: 将属性添加到 system properties 中，在 `action` 的持续期间内生效，并在其完成后恢复先前的值。

items.source: Add the properties to the system properties for the duration of the call, restoring previous values when it completes.
items.translation: 将属性添加到 system properties 中，在 `call` 的持续期间内有效，并在其完成时恢复先前的值。

items.source: Add the properties from the underlying map to the environment owned by an ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 将底层 Map 中的属性添加到由 ApplicationContext 拥有的环境中。

items.source: Add the properties from the underlying map to the environment. The default property source used is MapPropertySource.
items.translation: 将底层 Map 的属性添加到环境中。默认使用的属性源是 MapPropertySource。
